goal: alert me when the purchase tag stops firing
summary: Alerts in ObservePoint watch a number on a report widget, so we'll open the audit report, find the widget that shows "the purchase tag stops firing", and create the alert from its bell icon — that pre-fills the metric and filters. Notifications go to your account email.

steps.say: Open the audit whose report you want to watch. It needs at least one completed run — alerts read report data, so there is nothing to threshold until then.

targetFallback.description: the audit card on the Data Sources page

steps.say: Find the widget showing "the purchase tag stops firing" and click its bell. Creating the alert from the widget means the metric and filters are filled in for you.

targetFallback.description: the bell icon on the report widget

steps.say: Naming it "Copilot alert" — this is what appears in the notification, so make it obvious at 3am.
Sending notifications to your account email.
The default threshold is a sensible starting point. Customize it if "the purchase tag stops firing" needs a specific number rather than any change.
Save it. It evaluates after each run of this audit from now on.

targetFallback.description: the save button in the alert quick-create dialog
